pricing.hero: Invoice the world. Register a company when you are ready.
pricing.subhead: RemoteWise invoices on your behalf, collects payment, insures the work, and pays you out. You do not need a company to start. Companies manage contractors for free.
pricing.lightBody: {service}% service fee plus {shield}% RemoteWise Shield. Lowest total fee in Finland for this model. No monthly subscription to send invoices.
pricing.feat1: Invoice any client in EUR, USD, GBP, RUB, or CNY. We are the billing entity.
pricing.feat2: Shield covers accident, liability, and legal-expense on invoiced work.
pricing.feat3: Standard payout in 24 hours after the client pays. Free.
pricing.feat4: Lightning Pay: 1% (minimum €5) when you need the money now.
pricing.feat5: Invoice financing: 4% + €10 if you want to be paid before the client pays.
pricing.businessBody: $49 once, then $9.90/month for bookkeeping. Same product. Your own business ID when you want it.
pricing.debtNote: Optional later: debt collection at 8% of recovered amounts, only if we collect.
pricing.freePitch: The contractor OS. Unlimited people. Unlimited invoices.
pricing.free2: Pay invoices by card or transfer
pricing.free4: Auto tax reporting when you pay through us
pricing.growthPitch: Contracts, analytics, and seats when the roster grows.
pricing.scalePitch: Finance, API, and custom cover for operators.
pricing.scaleCta: Talk to us after you start
pricing.companyProcessingNote: Payment processing is 1.5% on top of the freelancer's {take}%. We do not hide it inside the contractor's payout.
pricing.faq1q: Do I need to register a company?
pricing.faq1a: No. Light entrepreneur mode lets you invoice as yourself. RemoteWise is the billing entity. You report the payout as income in your country. When you want a business ID, the $49 path is there.
pricing.faq2a: After the client pays, unless you buy invoice financing. Standard payout is 24 hours and free. Lightning Pay is 1% with a €5 minimum.
pricing.faq3a: Mandatory cover on invoiced work: accident, liability, and legal-expense. It is {shield}% of the VAT-exclusive amount. Every paid invoice gets a certificate.
pricing.faq4a: You do, in this phase. We do not withhold. Country modules (US 1099, UK, Estonia, India, Philippines) land later without changing this fee model.
pricing.faq5a: {take}% all-in ({service}% service + {shield}% Shield). That is the number we quote before you sign up.
pricing.faq6a: The contractor tool is free. Growth is $49/month. Scale is $149/month. Paying through RemoteWise adds 1.5% processing on the invoice amount. That 1.5% is not taken from the freelancer.
pricing.whySub: Lowest total fee in Finland, insurance on every invoice, and a free contractor OS for companies.
pricing.how1body: Add the client, line items, and currency. Creating an invoice is free.
pricing.how2body: Money lands with RemoteWise. We are the billing party, not you personally.
pricing.how3body: We deduct {take}% and attach a coverage certificate to that paid invoice.
pricing.how4body: 24 hours free, Lightning in minutes, or financing before the client pays.
pricing.better1body: {take}% all-in ({service}% service + {shield}% Shield). One number, insurance included, no surprise add-ons.
pricing.better2body: Accident, liability, and legal-expense cover on every paid invoice. Certificate attached automatically.
pricing.better3body: After the client pays, standard payout is free within 24 hours. Lightning is optional.
pricing.better4body: Light entrepreneur mode. Invoice as yourself. Register a Y-tunnus later if you want one.
pricing.better5body: Companies invite unlimited freelancers, send contracts, and pay invoices at $0/month.
pricing.better6body: Finnish and English. A person replies within a working day — not a ticket black hole.
pricing.tipF2: Attach the signed contract before starting work
pricing.tipF3: Save your tax residency and IBAN once — every invoice fills itself
pricing.tipC3: Pay through RemoteWise so Shield and reporting stay attached

pricing.promise2: Payout on time or we cover the delay
pricing.promise3: Cancel any invoice before it is paid

legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains how {operator} (“RemoteWise”, “we”, “us”) processes personal data when you use RemoteWise Teams: the company workspace, the freelancer portal, our public website, and related invoicing services. We process data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Data Protection Act (1050/2018).
legal.privacyP1: The controller is {entity}, established in {country}. Contact: privacy@remotewise.dev. Our supervisory authority is the {authority} ({url}).
legal.privacyL1: Account data: name, email, password hash (handled by Supabase Auth), headline, avatar.
legal.privacyL2: Company data: workspace name, logo, Y-tunnus, VAT ID, address, plan.
legal.privacyL3: Freelancer profile: country, tax residency, address, VAT ID, bank IBAN/name, saved clients.
legal.privacyL4: Transactional data: contracts, invoices, line items, payout elections, fee ledger.
legal.privacyL5: Usage data: login timestamps, settings tab, theme preference, cookie consent.
legal.privacyL6: Support tickets you send us (name, email, message).
legal.privacyP3: We process account and invoicing data to perform the contract with you (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)): creating invoices, collecting payment, paying you out, and issuing Shield certificates. We process tax identifiers and addresses to meet bookkeeping and AML-adjacent record duties (Art. 6(1)(c)). We process product emails and optional analytics only with consent or legitimate interest in running a secure service (Art. 6(1)(a) and (f)), and you can object.
legal.privacyP4: We share data with: (a) the other party on a contract or invoice (company ↔ freelancer); (b) infrastructure processors — currently Supabase (auth, database, storage) and, when configured, Resend (email) and Stripe (payments); (c) a future insurance partner for Shield certificates; (d) authorities when law requires. We do not sell personal data.
legal.privacyP5: Processors may store data in the EEA or in third countries. Where data leaves the EEA we use the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses and supplementary measures.
legal.privacyP6: Invoices, fee records, and identity data needed for bookkeeping are kept for {months} months (six Finnish accounting years) unless a longer period is required. Support tickets are kept for 24 months. Auth sessions expire according to the identity provider. You may request erasure of data that is not legally retained.
legal.privacyP7: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object, and port your data, and to withdraw consent. Use Settings → Data & privacy, or email privacy@remotewise.dev. You may lodge a complaint with the {authority}.
legal.privacyP8: Necessary cookies keep you signed in. Optional analytics cookies are used only after you choose “{accept}”. Details are in the Cookie policy. Policy version {version}.
legal.privacyP9: The service is for adults acting as businesses or independent contractors. We do not onboard minors.
legal.termsIntro: These terms are a tri-party agreement between (1) {entity} (“RemoteWise”, the platform), (2) the freelancer or light entrepreneur who invoices through the platform, and (3) the company that invites contractors or pays invoices. By creating an account you accept them. Governing law: {law}.
legal.termsP1: RemoteWise provides contractor management, e-signature contracts, invoicing, fee collection, payout routing, and (when issued) a Shield coverage certificate. The company workspace is free at the Free plan. Paid plans (Growth, Scale) add seats, analytics, and APIs as described on the pricing page. Light-entrepreneur invoicing is charged at {take}% of the VAT-exclusive invoice amount (service fee + Shield).
legal.termsP2: RemoteWise is the billing entity for light-entrepreneur invoices. The freelancer is not required to hold a Finnish Y-tunnus to start. RemoteWise is not the freelancer’s employer, and is not a party to the underlying services contract except as billing agent and platform operator. {tax}
legal.termsF1: Provide accurate identity, tax residency, and payout details.
legal.termsF2: Only invoice work you are legally allowed to perform.
legal.termsF3: Report payouts as income in your tax residency.
legal.termsF4: Keep client information truthful on each invoice.
legal.termsF5: Not use the platform for sanctioned, fraudulent, or illegal activity.
legal.termsC1: Invite only people you intend to contract with.
legal.termsC2: Pay invoices you accept through the platform when due.
legal.termsC3: Not misclassify employees as contractors where local law forbids it.
legal.termsC4: Keep workspace member access limited to people who need it.
legal.termsP5: Headline freelancer take rate, Shield, Lightning Pay, financing, and company processing fees are published on /pricing and shown line-by-line before an invoice is sent. Changing a fee for future invoices requires notice on the site. Fees already quoted on a sent invoice stay fixed for that invoice.
legal.termsP6: You keep IP in your work product as agreed in your contract with the other party. RemoteWise keeps IP in the software, templates, and brand. You grant us a licence to host documents you upload solely to operate the service.
legal.termsP7: To the extent permitted by Finnish law, RemoteWise is not liable for indirect loss. Nothing excludes liability for intent, gross negligence, or death/personal injury. Consumer users in the EEA keep mandatory rights, including access to the {disputes} and the EU ODR platform ({odr}).
legal.termsP8: You may export and close your account in Settings. We may suspend access for fraud, unpaid platform fees, or legal risk. Surviving clauses: fees owed, IP, liability, governing law.
legal.termsP9: First contact support@remotewise.dev (we reply within {hours} hours, FI + EN). Unresolved B2B disputes are submitted to the district courts of Finland. Consumers may use {disputes}.
legal.invIntro: These invoicing terms sit under the Terms of service. They apply to every invoice created on RemoteWise. {vat}
legal.invP1: Creating a draft is free. Fees ({take}% service + Shield on the VAT-exclusive amount, plus any Lightning or financing add-on you choose) are calculated before send and stored on the invoice. The sender profile (address, tax residency, VAT ID, bank, default client) is saved once and reused.
legal.invP2: Draft → Sent → Paid → Payout processing → Paid out. An invoice may also fail or be cancelled. Standard payout is 24 hours after client payment and is free.
legal.invP3: The freelancer may cancel an invoice while it is in draft or sent status. Cancellation requires confirmation, writes an audit event, and notifies the company workspace. After the client has paid, cancellation is not available; use a refund or credit as in section 5.
legal.invP4: A company may dispute a sent invoice within 14 days of receipt by writing to billing@remotewise.dev with the invoice number and grounds. We freeze payout on a disputed unpaid invoice until the parties agree or 30 days pass. We are not an arbitral tribunal for the underlying services — we pause money movement and share the paper trail.
legal.invP5: If a paid invoice is reversed by the payment provider or both parties agree a refund, RemoteWise returns the client’s principal minus non-recoverable card fees. Shield already issued for that invoice is voided. The freelancer must repay any payout already received on that invoice.
legal.invP6: Unless the invoice states otherwise, payment is due 14 days after send. We may send reminders at day 7 and day 14 past due. Finnish late-payment interest may apply to B2B invoices under the Interest Act (633/1982) when the payer is established in Finland.
legal.invP7: Undisputed overdue amounts may be placed with a licensed collection partner. Collection is optional and charged only on success, at 8% of the recovered amount, disclosed before we place the file. We do not sell debt.
legal.invP8: If a standard payout is late because of a RemoteWise systems fault after the client’s funds have cleared, we cover reasonable documented delay costs up to the Shield fee on that invoice. Payment-provider or bank holidays are not a RemoteWise fault.
legal.cookIntro: This policy describes cookies and similar storage used on RemoteWise, in line with the ePrivacy Directive as implemented in Finland and GDPR. Version {version}.
legal.cookAnalyticsPurpose: Product usage in aggregate — not sold
legal.cookP2: Necessary cookies load without consent because the service cannot sign you in without them. Optional analytics load only after you press “{accept}” on the banner. “{necessary}” rejects analytics. You can change your mind by clearing site data and reloading, then using the banner again.
